webhooks.detail: Synchronous Commerce webhooks plus asynchronous Adobe I/O Events (e.g. plugin.magento.sales.api.order_management.place) for event-driven apps

evidence.quote: Webhooks enable developers to configure synchronous logic to execute calls to external systems when an Adobe Commerce event triggers.

sandbox.detail: No self-serve free sandbox found. Magento Open Source is free to self-host. An Adobe Commerce sandbox is given to Technology Partner Program members on request via support ticket.

evidence.quote: Be in good standing in the Commerce Marketplace.

rate_limits.summary: Only optional order-placement throttling, off by default: per-guest (IP) and per-customer request limits over 60/3600/86400s. No general REST/GraphQL limit documented.

evidence.quote: Rate limiting is disabled by default.
Commerce SDKs and libraries provide reusable patterns for authentication, configuration, event handling, and Commerce integration, including the Admin UI SDK and OOPE modules.
You can also use introspection queries to discover the schema programmatically.
